description: COBOL word length ceiling raised to 63 characters (ISO §2023:8.3.2.1) — a COBOL-2023 RELAXATION (E.3.3 item 11: was 31 in 2002/2014, 30 in 1985). A 42-character user-defined word compiles at 2023 and is rejected below 2023 (COBOL1567 — a ceiling that TIGHTENS below 2023, the opposite direction from a new-feature introduction gate). A word longer than 63 characters is rejected at EVERY edition.
